summary: IDS feed 'combined_2' is degraded: 81.3% encrypted traffic exceeds 60% IDS tolerance and 4.6% TCP packet loss indicates incomplete capture, both severely reducing detection coverage.

findings.root_cause: 81.3% of bytes are encrypted (threshold 60% for this IDS), likely TLS 1.3/QUIC without visibility-layer decryption, leaving payloads opaque to the IDS.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS requires full payload inspection but cannot analyze encrypted content, causing missed signatures, blind spots for malware/C2 and reduced detection efficacy.

recommended_fix.why: Decrypt via trusted proxy/broker or selectively forward decrypted traffic to bring encrypted share below 60% and restore payload visibility for IDS analysis

findings.root_cause: 4.6% of TCP packets (136 of 2957) show evidence of missing data/gaps, indicating SPAN/mirror or packet broker buffer drops and oversubscription before delivery to the IDS.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS needs both directions and full payload for TCP reassembly; missing segments break stream reassembly, cause missed signatures, false negatives and potential evasion.

recommended_fix.why: Hardware TAP with aggregation eliminates SPAN buffer drops and delivers complete, ordered packets required for reliable IDS reassembly
